note: NANDINV circuit (per-gate NAND/AND choice via --gate nandinv). SAT solver proves this achieves exact fits (slack=0) on patterns where plain NAND requires slack>0. Key improvement: 3-bit key + 5 patterns = SAT (5/5 exact) for nandinv vs UNSAT for nand.
gate_note: Each gate is NAND(a,b) when inv=0 or AND(a,b) when inv=1. Same gate count, expanded function class.
